title: World of Stadiums - World of Stadiums
content: # World of Stadiums. Welcome to World of Stadiums, the ultimate guide to stadiums from all over the world. Our main database has information about **2,316** stadiums with a capacity of at least 10,000. World of Stadiums offers information pages about football, the most popular sport in the world. The page with large stadiums is about stadiums with a capacity of at least 30,000. Stadium news is also included on World of Stadiums. ##### **World of Stadiums on social media**. Our Facebook page has past and pre-renovation stadiums with a capacity of at least 10,000. The World of Stadiums X page has past, pre-renovation and present stadiums with a capacity of at least 5,000 and below 10,000. Our Flickr account has pictures of stadiums with a capacity of at least 5,000 taken by the World of Stadiums webmaster. Real Madrid from Spain became the first sports club with 100 million followers on its main social media page, followed by FC Barcelona.
